data.name: Pradyumna
data.gender_notes: Pradyumna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pradyumna is a renowned warrior and the son of Krishna and Rukmini. He is known for his bravery and is often depicted as an embodiment of fearlessness. The name Pradyumna carries the meaning “Brave, Intrepid Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pradyumna usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, intrepid warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and fearlessness in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Pradyumna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Intrepid Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pradyumna total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

celebrity_usage: Pradyumna is a character in the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Purana.
data.cultural_impact: Pradyumna is a significant figure in Indian mythology, particularly in the Mahabharata and the Bhagavata Purana. He is celebrated for his bravery and is revered as a symbol of fearlessness and strength. Pradyumna is often depicted leading armies in battle and defeating powerful opponents, making him a source of inspiration for warriors and leaders throughout Indian history. His name is still popular in India and Nepal, with many individuals bearing it as a testament to his enduring legacy.
data.spiritual_significance: Pradyumna's name is derived from the Sanskrit words "pradhin" (leader) and "umna" (fear). This suggests that Pradyumna represents the power to overcome fear and lead with courage and confidence. He is an embodiment of the divine qualities of bravery and fearlessness, qualities that are highly valued in Hindu spirituality. In addition, Pradyumna is believed to be an avatar of Vishnu, the preserving deity in the Hindu Trimurti. As such, his name is a reminder of the divine presence and protection that is always with us, even in the most challenging of times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pradyumna symbolizes dynamic, passionate, and fearless devotion to one's spiritual path. Named after the radiant and valor-filled son of Krishna and Rukmini, this name ignites the inner flame of determination and courage, inspiring one to overcome all obstacles on their spiritual journey.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Mahabharata, Son of Krishna and Rukmini
vedic_reference.note: Pradyumna is a revered and important character in Hindu mythology. He is the eldest son of Lord Krishna and Rukmini. Pradyumna is known for his strength, bravery, and wisdom. He is often depicted as an embodiment of grace and is revered by many Hindus.

historical_references.reference: Pradyumna is the eldest son of Krishna and Rukmini. He is named Pradyumna because he leapt from Krishna's womb before his twin brother Anirudda.

Pradyumna is also mentioned in Jain texts as a teacher and a Tirthankara candidate, but there is a difference in opinion among scholars regarding his exact identity in Jainism and the time period of his life.

modern_usage.modern_context: Pradyumna is a name of Hindu origin. In modern context, it's associated with individuals who have a multifaceted personality and excel in various domains. Three platforms where this name is often seen are LinkedIn for professional achievements, Instagram for personal branding as a musician or actor, and YouTube for sharing knowledge and creativity in literature, mythology, or spirituality.
